goal: Test whether the binary inclusion history of each lottery number contains reproducible variable-order temporal memory that improves a frozen top-8 pool over a same-window order-0 frequency model and an exact random pool.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: v111 detects run-length/change points; v319 predicts number inclusion from explicit finite binary contexts.
v308 diffuses scores over a co-occurrence graph; v319 uses only each number's own temporal inclusion sequence.

model.binarySequence: For each number n, x_t(n)=1 if n appears among the six main numbers in draw t, otherwise 0.
model.contextOrders: For each candidate maximum order D, compute KT-smoothed conditional probabilities for context depths d=0..D using only the frozen trailing window before the target draw.
model.ktEstimate: p_d=(ones_after_context+0.5)/(context_occurrences+1). If a nonzero-depth context has zero occurrences, its KT value is 0.5 and receives its predeclared mixture weight.
model.mixtureWeights: w_d proportional to 2^(-d), d=0..D, normalized to sum 1; fixed before execution and never fit to outcomes.
model.prediction: p_mix(n)=sum_d w_d*p_d(n). Rank 1..49 descending by p_mix; ties by number ascending; select top 8.
model.nestedControl: D=0 using the same trailing window and KT estimate.
